system.description:
A simple illusion of sight. When hit by an attack, the opponent sees you burst into black raven feathers reforming at your current location. When hit by a melee attack, roll 1d4 reducing damage taken by the result and move 10 feet away. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

At Higher Levels: This Jutsu’s proficiency increases as you increase in level rolling 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), 17th level (4d4).
